initial_weights_source: Local completed b0_s960_v1 best checkpoint; provenance in experiment.json, not a new download
paper_recipe_vs_adaptation: AdamW paper decouples weight decay from adaptive updates; SGDR motivates cosine decay but this run has NO warm restarts. Apply standard YOLOv8s loss and optimizer options in pinned Ultralytics8.4.178. Project-selected lr0.0003/nbs32/60epochs and reduced geometry augmentation are not paper-optimal claims. AMP follows PyTorch autocast/GradScaler; official Ultralytics may download a small YOLO26n auxiliary checkpoint only for its AMP check, not as the training model.
experiment_purpose: Prior full run stopped at11, best at1, best reval about mAP50.698/mAP95.559/recall.582. Test a substantial combined optimization/regularization/resource revision on identical2988images, same307val and initial checkpoint; not a single-factor ablation.
hardware_decision: One free Tesla T4 GPU0, batch8 AMP FP16/FP32, workers2, nbs32 (about4-batch accumulation after warmup); no DDP. Require three backward+optimizer steps on a disposable copy with real TRAIN images/labels before actual epochs. No automatic batch fallback.

secondary_checks: Fixed confidence.25/IoU.5 precision,recall,F1 and negative-image FP rate on same enlarged val
Prior217-image validation subset retained via source provenance for diagnosing recall drift

limitations: Combined recipe experiment on repeatedly used validation, not guaranteed improvement or an independent-test claim. No new events or labels, no promise of70percent. Resource precheck is not a guarantee for all augmentation batches.
training_mode: New named run from original locked s960 checkpoint; not resume and not downloading weak previous run weights.
migration_note: Same dataset bytes/labels/splits and initial weights as full v1. Runtime overlay is separately hashed; original bundle and manifest remain unchanged. Early stopping counter starts only after epoch25, patience25, earliest plateau stop epoch50. Validation only, test/reserve excluded.
